definitions.explanation: The clinical or neutral term for fecal matter or the act of defecation. Used in medical settings and in everyday conversation as a more polite alternative to cruder terms.

examples.japanese: {便|べん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おかしい→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧。
examples.english: The color of my stool is unusual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{便|べん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦チェックしている→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I check the condition of the baby's stool every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{便|べん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採取|さいしゅ}→採取：12901_saishu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please collect and submit a stool sample for the health checkup.

notes:
The standard neutral/medical term for feces and bowel movements. In medical contexts this is by far the most common word. In everyday conversation, people often use the more casual ⟦うんち→うんち：09084_unchi⟧ (for children or casual talk) or ⟦{大便|だいべん}→大便：24207_daiben⟧ (more formal/clinical).

Note that the kanji {便|べん} also has the reading びん meaning "mail; flight; service" (as in ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ or ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧), which is a separate word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{便秘|べんぴ}→便秘：05383_benpi⟧: constipation
- {軟便|なんべん}: soft stool
- {硬便|こうべん}: hard stool
- {血便|けつべん}: bloody stool
- {便意|べんい}: urge to defecate
- {便|べん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to have a bowel movement
- {便|べん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: stool test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大便|だいべん}→大便：24207_daiben⟧: feces — more formal, explicitly distinguishes from urine (⟦{小便|しょうべん}→小便：28713_shouben⟧)
- ⟦うんち→うんち：09084_unchi⟧: poop — childish or casual term
- ⟦{排便|はいべん}→排便：26322_haiben⟧: defecation — the formal act itself
